|{1:* }{2:bold}{1: one}|
|{3:** }{4:bold}{3: two}|
|{5:*** }{6:bold}{5: three}|
|{7:**** }{8:italic}{7: and }{9:bold}{7: four}|
|{10:***** }{11:under}{10: }{12:verbatim}{10: }{13:code}{10: }{14:strike}{10: five}|
|Body with {15:bold}, {16:italic} and {17:verbatim}.|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgBold [bold]
{3} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgBold [bold]
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{6} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgBold [bold]
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{8} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgItalic [bold, italic]
{9} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgBold [bold]
{10} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{11} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgUnderline [underline]
{12} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgVerbatim -> String
{13} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgCode -> String
{14} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgStrikethrough [strikethrough]
{15} OrgBold [bold]
{16} OrgItalic [italic]
{17} OrgVerbatim -> String
